name: Eleven Voice Dubbing Dubbing
description: Eleven Voice Dubbing Dubbing is available in the Business API catalog.

source_url.description: URL of the source audio or video to dub.
source_url.title: Source Url

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the source media in seconds.
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

target_lang.description: ISO language code to dub the media into.
target_lang.title: Target Lang

source_lang.description: ISO language code of the source. Defaults to auto-detection.
source_lang.title: Source Lang

watermark.description: Whether to add a watermark to the dubbed output.
watermark.title: Watermark

num_speakers.description: Number of speakers to detect. Defaults to auto-detection.
num_speakers.title: Num Speakers

highest_resolution.description: Whether to render video dubs at the highest available resolution.
highest_resolution.title: Highest Resolution

drop_background_audio.description: Whether to remove background audio from the source.
drop_background_audio.title: Drop Background Audio
